quest.05B6DB75AEC01187.quest_desc: RFTools Power has &9Powercells&r to store power, which are multi-block storage units that can be customized and upgraded to store power.\n\nYou will need a Wrench to determine inputs and outputs for power.

quest.672134A1A620EEAB.quest_desc: There are many ways to store power!
&9Powah&r offers great storage using &aEnergy Cells&r that can be upgraded, or you can always go with the multiblock style of &aRFTools&r using &aPowercells&r! The choice is yours.
Note: You only have to make one of the items to complete the quest.
